result.fix: Raise the ceiling first: `echo 'fs.nr_open = 2097152' | sudo tee -a /etc/sysctl.d/99-rdy.conf`, then run `sysctl --system`. Then set the limit for the service.
result.message: `fs.nr_open` is 1048576, so no service can have 2097152 open files.
notes: rdy's own open files limit is 1024 (soft) and 524288 (hard). That is a shell limit and does not apply to services.
